makers-450736.summary: The UNI-T UT312A is a handheld vibration tester designed for quick, accurate measurement of machine vibration to aid in maintenance and troubleshooting.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT312A presents itself as a thoughtful blend of precision instrumentation and field-ready ergonomics. Housed in a slender, split-type enclosure, the tester separates its sensing head containing a high-sensitivity piezoelectric accelerometer from its display module via a short, flex-rated cable. This layout lets technicians position the compact sensor in tight or awkward locations on shafts, bearings, or curved surfaces while comfortably holding the controls and screen at arm’s length.

At the heart of the display module lies a 2.4-inch full-view TFT color LCD that automatically reorients itself with gravity, ensuring that readouts remain upright whether the unit is held vertically, horizontally, or at an angle. Surrounding the screen, three rubber-tactile buttons offer intuitive access to power, measurement modes, and flashlight or screen-lock functions without obscuring the view or requiring menu diving. An integrated LED lamp, activated by a long press on the flashlight button, bathes poorly lit measurement points in bright, focused light eliminating the need for external illumination and speeding workflow in dim environments.

UNI-T’s industrial designers encase the unit in a rugged plastic shell with gently chamfered corners and a stippled grip zone, balancing toughness against fatigue-resistant handling during extended inspections. The sensor head itself is machined to a low profile and may be equipped with either short or long probes (or, uniquely for the UT312A, a U-shaped magnetic mount) to accommodate flat, irregular, or hard-to-reach surfaces.

Power is delivered via a 3.7 V/1350 mAh rechargeable lithium pack, accessed and topped up through a USB-C port. A discreet LED charge indicator glows red during charging and green at completion, while the unit’s firmware gracefully dims and shuts off the backlight after brief inactivity preserving battery life without sacrificing responsiveness when you return to the task at hand.

Together, these design choices make the UT312A more than a mere readout instrument; it feels like an extension of the technician’s hand nimble, clear-eyed, and ready to tackle vibration diagnostics anywhere at any hour.

blocks.text: 4016 IC Quad Analog Switch Quad Multiplexer DIP 14-pin

The CD4016BC is a monolithic integrated circuit constructed using complementary MOS (CMOS) technology. It functions as a quad bilateral switch, meaning it contains four independent electronic switches within a single package. The primary role of this IC is to control the transmission or routing of electrical signals, acting as a gate that can be opened or closed via an external control voltage.

Each of the four switches is bidirectional, allowing analog or digital signals to pass in either direction when the switch is turned “ON”. The state of each switch (ON or OFF) is determined by a separate digital control input. A high logic level on this control pin closes the switch, creating a conductive path, while a low logic level opens the switch, resulting in a very high impedance (open circuit) between the input and output terminals.

The CD4016BC is designed for a wide supply voltage range, making it versatile for various system voltages. A key point of differentiation is its simpler two-transistor switch design compared to other similar ICs, which contributes to its performance profile. It is particularly noted for its high degree of signal linearity when ON and extremely low signal leakage when OFF, making it suitable for precision analog signal switching and multiplexing applications.

Unlike simple latches, the SN74HC574N ensures data transfer only occurs on clock transitions, making it suitable for controlled timing applications in microprocessor data registers, buffers, and other storage elements. void tcaSelect(uint8_t ch) { Wire.beginTransmission(0x70); Wire.write(1 << ch); Wire.endTransmission(); }
Call tcaSelect(0); before talking to the device on channel 0, then tcaSelect(1); for the next one, and so on.

As most filaments are made from plastics, they are often statically charged and attract all sorts of debris from around your filament storage or workspace.
The anti-static filament cleaner wipes lint, dust, or other dirt before the filament enters your printer’s valuable extruder and nozzle.
The use of the Filament Cleaner Block will prevent your nozzle from being blocked by a buildup of debris and extend your nozzle’s and hot-end’s useful life.

As the filament is pulled through the cleaner block, dust, hair, small plastic, or other material shavings are wiped off the surface of the filament. As hot-ends, extruders and nozzles are getting more and more sophisticated and monolithic, repair or replacement is costly and also can incur quite some printer downtime. This filament cleaner prevents all this and keeps you printing without interruption.

The 3S 40A Lithium Battery BMS Protection Board (Enhanced) is a battery management circuit built for three-cell (3S) lithium-ion or LiFePO4 packs, guarding against overcharge, over-discharge and short-circuit conditions during everyday use. Its enhanced design supports higher continuous current for e-bikes, power tools and DIY battery packs.
Cell Configuration: Designed for 3S lithium battery packs with an 11.1V to 12.6V nominal range.
Continuous Current: Rated for up to 40A of continuous charge and discharge current.
Overcharge & Overdischarge Protection: Automatically disconnects the pack when any cell voltage goes out of range.
Short-Circuit & Overcurrent Protection: Instantly cuts power if a fault is detected on the output.
Cell Balancing: Helps keep individual cell voltages even while charging.
Low Standby Consumption: Minimal quiescent current preserves battery charge when idle.
It’s a compact, reliable safety layer for 3S packs built from 18650 or similar lithium cells.
